The pressure tank system shall be designed by a registered design professional. An application for a permit and plans shall be filed with the department. The plans and application shall contain, but not be limited to:
   1.   Size and location of high pressure tanks;
   2.   The operating pressures and temperatures; and
   3.   The location, type and specifications of pressure relief valves.

The pressure tank system shall be designed by a registered design professional. An application for a permit and plans shall be filed with the department. The plans and application shall contain, but not be limited to: 

 1. Size and location of high pressure tanks; 

 2. The operating pressures and temperatures; and 

 3. The location, type and specifications of pressure relief valves.
